answer: Like a glacier grinding shale into layers, an agent economy can make Sybil identities expensive through joint-liability collateral clusters: every identity posts a bond, and identities funded from the same source are grouped so one fraud slashes the whole cluster's stake. A lantern of transparency - the public funding graph - lets anyone see which identities share a purse. An attacker must then fund each fake separately with unlinked capital, and each fraud risks the entire cluster, so cloning stops paying.
